subject: K-Beauty Platform
body:
Hi David and Hoon,

 

Miri and I have been going back and forth, brainstorming names for the
platform. I think it will help us in the
branding/design/aesthetic/positioning process. We wanted to get your
initial input on some of the options. 

 

Attached is a list of names we have been discussing, opposite brief
explanations, as well as any questions and concerns we had in the process.

 

We are looking for a name that feels distinctive and commercially strong
in Israel and internationally, while having either a certain Korean
reference or a meaningful story behind it.

 

We would really value your candid perspective. 

 

In particular, please don't hesitate to tell us if any of these sound
awkward, childish, unnatural, overly manufactured, have an unintended
meaning or association in Korean, or simply don't feel like a name you
would expect to see on a sophisticated beauty platform.

 

And of course, any and all additional suggestions are welcome.

 

Will we be speaking on Thursday at the regular time?

 

Thank you,

 

Arielle

subject: RE: New Partnership Opportunity – OOTD x MY K
body:
Dear Nina, Dear Angela,

I am honored to connect with you both and the organization. On behalf of my 
team, I would like to sincerely thank you for the opportunity to represent 
your brand in our market. We highly value our partnership and remain fully 
committed to supporting the brand's long-term success.

As we continue to build and strengthen the brand in our Region, I would be 
grateful for your guidance and support in the following areas:

1. Training & Educational Materials

To ensure that our team and sales partners communicate the brand 
consistently and accurately, we would greatly appreciate access to any 
available training resources, such as product presentations, brand 
materials, ingredient information, training guides, comparison sheets, and 
online learning resources.

These materials would help us better educate our teams and represent the 
brand according to your standards and vision.

Having access to these materials will allow us to educate our team 
thoroughly and represent the brand in the most professional manner possible.

2. Media Library Access

We would also be grateful to receive access to a centralized media library 
where we can download and utilize approved brand assets, such as:

*	High-resolution product images & Lifestyle visuals
*	Videos and animations
*	Campaign materials & Product brochures
*	Digital assets for e-commerce and social media
*	Brand book & brand guidelines

Easy access to these resources is essential for product listings, retailer 
communication, marketing campaigns, POS materials and overall brand 
development within our market.

3. Product FOC Support

We fully understand and appreciate your current FOC policy for new customer 
acquisition.

At the same time, based on our local market experience, FOC products can 
also play an important role in supporting brand growth through:

*	New product listings within existing retail partners;
*	Retail buyer evaluations;
*	PR and media outreach;
*	Influencer collaborations, content creators & product reviews – kindly 
consider that we monthly send more than 300 PR kit only in this channel, and 
will be our joy to have an autumn season reach-out for your brand
*	Training, demo and educational activities.

These initiatives are important investments in brand awareness, product 
result-oriented reputation, and consumer adoption, ultimately contributing

subject: הזמנת מוצרי קיי ביוטי
body:
היי גלעד ודיויד,

מצרפת קובץ הזמנה למוצרי קיי ביוטי. כמה נקודות חשובות:

1.	האם לצורך ביצוע ההזמנה עלינו לחתום על חוזה מול הספקים הקוריאנים?
בכמה ספקים מדובר? אנא הרחיבו על אופן ההתנהלות
2.	כמובן שלפני אישור ההזמנה עלינו לוודא שמקבלים את כל המסמכים
הרגולטוריים
3.	אודה לקבלת המחירון של המותג Dr.Althea, כרגע יש לי רק את המחיר של
345 Relief Cream 50 ml.
4.	אשמח לקבל מחירון גם של המותג SOMEBYMI
5.	במותג ANUA הברקודים בקובץ המחירון מהספק אינם תואמים לברקודים הסופר
פארם. הוספתי עמודה עם הברקודים המקומיים, אנא בדקו מול הספק מדוע יש שוני
בין הברקודים וודאו שאנו מקבלים ברקודים שמתאימים לשוק המקומי.
6.	במותג מדיקיוב:

א. אנא בדקו לגבי הוזלת מחירי קנייה, כרגע המחירים יחסית גבוהים ולא בטוחה
שנצליח להתקדם איתם

ב.אנחנו רוצים להזמין להתנסות 3 יח' של אחד ממוצרי המכשור יופי שלהם. האם
לצורך קבלת הדוגמאות יש צורך לבצע מכון תקנים? האם יש איזה מגבלה בקבלת כמות
